parameters.name: segmentation
parameters.value: SentencePiece subword tokenizer using byte pair encoding (BPE)

evidence.quote: The data were tokenized with the byte pair encoding (BPE) algorithm 11 .

parameters.name: alignment
parameters.value: token embeddings with GPTNeo positional encodings

decisions.chain_element: embed the input tokens and add GPTNeo positional encodings
